High-fashion black-and-white portrait with flat, even lighting and minimal shadows, creating a clean, editorial aesthetic against a plain white backdrop. The subject is leaning back against the wall, framed from mid-thigh upward with a slightly low-angle composition that emphasizes posture and presence. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm or 85mm lens for crisp detail and controlled depth of field.

TOK is a mixed hispanic-white male aged 35 to 39, athletic and muscular build; short black hair; dark brown eyes. TOK is wearing a light colored tailored striped suit consisting of a double-breasted blazer and high-waisted pleated trousers. Underneath, he has a vertically striped button-up shirt, fully fastened to the collar combining classic menswear tailoring with a confident, modern edge. Tok has a genuine smile.
